b4/host/b4_carto.py.note: the observation cartographer (closed-book: single-bit pairs under one stimulus -> seen cells / presence / no effect seen / context-dependent / unknown; multi-bit pairs counted, never decomposed; no semantic claim), the operator's groups, the v3 draft's shape check, control X (the derangement rule and the shadow isomorphism derived from B3's control-X contract, re-aimed at the eight visible lanes), A0, D and the PRIVILEGED oracle view.; X-A: derangement_attempts (every attempt kept), relabel_genome, isomorphic_addresses (the full shadow contract under π), residual_structure (post hoc); the lane permutation kept as the symmetry test

b4/host/b4_controls.py.note: unit 2b-4a A: the X and D control seeds (sha256('b4-x-control-1|l|o') / ('b4-d-control-1|l|o')[:4], 32-bit ints, never bools); F's frozen view REBUILT from the base and the 21 probe records with a fresh cartographer and held to every record and to the result's final fields, after a replay with no finding, on a complete, learned, non-privileged F result under the formal source only; D as that view through shuffled_view once with the permutation reconstructed and the residual reported, identity or partition-preserving kept, never redrawn; verify_d_view for a recorded given view.

b4/host/b4_deadline.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: the soft monotonic deadline (time.monotonic; UTC only a timestamp): check() between work units raises StopWork; a started unit is never interrupted; the record carries seconds / elapsed / checks / first expiry.

b4/host/b4_engine.py.note: B2's (mu, lambda) = (4, 8), KMAX = 4 engine re-implemented over the FF universe with the execution boundary at every observation: the arms R / F (a seeded probe pass, then frozen; or a given view with its provenance) / O / X, DOMAIN termination (the measured prefix, the pending children, no further draw, observation, score, selection or learning, the generator not rolled back), the ledger with map versions and commitments, generation closes, the holdout once for a completed run. Provenance: the observation source's identity (hypothesis digest and fixture marker, certificate digest) bound into the result and every ledger entry; a given view kept with its provenance chain; a DOMAIN at the holdout keeps the search's champion without a holdout score.; X-A: arm X over relabelled addresses with its own control seed, π drawn before the base observation from the control generator, the shadow contract after every ingest, a control failure as its own event at a stated commit point, the residual structure post hoc

b4/host/b4_execution.py.note: the execution boundary: ObservationPort (observe and the addresses, nothing else), SpyPort, PublicTask, TerminalEvent / Terminated / OtherRefusal, observe_candidate (DOMAIN -> a terminal event with the state before the call; any other refusal by its name). The strict source-identity validator (provenance_findings: hypothesis, mapping and FABRIC fields, exact types, 64-hex digests), SourceRefusal, the finite refusal kinds and raise_refusal.

b4/host/b4_ff_hypothesis.py.note: the behaviour hypothesis loader: load() takes no path, reads the committed v0.3 file only against the pinned HYPOTHESIS_SHA256, holds the shape (validated enum readings; unknown only in clock_mode's latch context) and re-hashes every named source, always; any other document — a valid copy included — enters through fixture() / fixture_file() and is marked; the decode by equality with clock_mode per storage context and unknown readings reported. v0.3: the pointer and the pin rotated; no logic changed.

b4/host/b4_ff_mapping.py.note: the certificate mapping of one site, read from the committed certificate against its pinned digest (another file only with its digest given explicitly); address ranges, endpoint existence and site; each token's reading DIRECTION is the class's (every token direct but NOCLKINV, negated) and the row's negated / expected_value / transition must agree with it; the two readings of a shared bit must be complementary; the project's bit readings held to the certificate's specimen pairs.

b4/host/b4_ff_model.py.note: the simulated fabric: configuration + stimulus -> the EXECUTING SIDE's trace under a mapping and a hypothesis passed in separately; the decode and everything derived from it host-only (diagnose / step_diagnostics); validation of the configuration, every step as handed and the init step's context at the entry; a configuration outside the domain refused with the fixed code DOMAIN and no reason (never a specimen, a redraw condition or a map-update signal); fixtures truth / permuted / dropout and seven hypothesis swaps. Every Fabric carries a source descriptor (kind, effect digest, dropout digest and count, seed — digests only) in every trace header.

b4/host/b4_gate_stats.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: median / percentile / mean / cohen_d / sign_test_p / bootstrap_reject_rate / required_pairs copied VERBATIM from host/b2_gate.py (the source text of each held equal to the original's by read-only import in the tests; per-function digests of the copied source above); dependencies math / statistics / random only; required_pairs_scan = the same complete ascending scan with a deadline check before each N (identical numbers); encode_stat / finite_findings for JSON without NaN / Infinity (a +inf Cohen's d kept as a named special, never 0).

b4/host/b4_k10.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: K10's driver — the two fixed backgrounds (0 and the salted generator's first uniform(1 << 21), equal ones kept), 2 x 210 four-corner units through b4_stats.four_corner with every corner's genome / score / observation kept, the per-seed max and outcome at tau = 2, a comparable = False return escalated at once to K10Invalid with the partial kept (never 'not comparable'), the deadline between units, the offline recompute.

b4/host/b4_k9.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: K9's fixed comparison set (section 9.3): the 64 backgrounds, the forced pairs (32 per slice-wide, 64 per per-element address; 1 184), applicability from the host decode of the two endpoints only (x5FF under a latch, sr_kind under a latch; storage_kind with presence), the differences by position and kind, the per-semantic / per-address counts (an empty denominator not assessable, never 100 %), the deadline between pairs, and the offline recompute from the kept grids.

b4/host/b4_landscape.py.note: the public task generator task-v0.1 (stimulus, mask, target, weights from the landscape seed alone; the all-zero base declared; the holdout stimulus its own derivation) and the scoring (None scores nothing, is counted, never moves the ceiling).

b4/host/b4_observe.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: the per-seed observation memo of K9 / K10 — (genome, stimulus digest) under ONE source identity held by provenance_findings; every unique observation kept whole (config digest, stimulus digest, provenance digest, trace digest, the full q grid); true port calls vs cache hits; DOMAIN propagates; enters no ledger.

b4/host/b4_replay.py.note: replay as RE-EXECUTION: the engine run again from the declared inputs against a ledger-backed port that serves the recorded observations in order, raises the recorded refusal at its attempt and holds every call to the record; the whole result compared field by field; the authenticity limit stated (the execution sequence is proved, the observations' origin is bound, not re-derived). Validation total and type-exact before any use; refusals re-raised by their finite kind; a malformed record a named finding, an internal error reported as such.; X-A: π re-derived from the control seed and compared with the record, the control fields typed and X's only, a recorded control failure must reproduce

b4/host/b4_rng.py.note: the line's PRNG (xorshift64 over a 32-bit seed, uniform by rejection, partial Fisher-Yates sample) copied from b1_carto.Rng with a state() accessor added; behavioural equality held by b4/tests/test_b4_rng.py by import of the pinned original (read-only).

b4/host/b4_seeds.py.note: unit 2b-4a A: the seed anchor (sha256(label|anchor)[:4], the label beside the anchor, '|' in a label refused); the 38 historical exclusion sources of docs/b4_architecture.md section 9.2 read against their digests through TYPED field paths (no count / version / timestamp can be read as a seed); B2's EXCLUDED_SEEDS copied and held to the pinned file's text; B4's exposed literal values; the evidence/b4/sim/ registry of every archived set (a run directory without a valid seed record is refused); one pooled set; pair_seeds copied from host/b2_search.py (held equal to the original by import in the tests, read-only). Runtime imports no pinned module.

b4/host/b4_sim.py.note: unit 2b-4a C: the host-only exploration harness — a pre-flight that writes nothing on refusal (label b4-sim-<n>, a clean tree with no override, the formal source, the root's inputs at their pinned digests, every exclusion source, an output directory directly under evidence/b4/sim/ created exclusively); seeds.json then manifest.json then the first observation; per pair R > F > O > X > D > Omega > A0 on one worker, each RunResult written exclusively before its audit, the typed completion checks, replay, ledger recompute, given-view checks, D from F's rebuilt map, K7 prefixes, K9, K10, curves, the pair index, the HEAD / input checkpoint; fail-closed stops (invalid / incomplete) with STOPPED.json, a typed sim_report.json always and a pooled summary only when complete; values beside the section-9 thresholds, no verdict field; exit codes 0 / 1 / 2 / 3. Running it is a separate authorisation.

b4/host/b4_sim_schema.py.note: unit 2b-4a C: typed validators (named findings, total over keys, type-exact scalars) for every file the harness writes — seeds, manifest, arm result (the engine's shape check), arm audit, controls, k7, k9, k10, curves, pair index, STOPPED, INIT_FAILED, the report (a summary only when complete; no verdict-like key) — applied before each write and offline over a run directory.

b4/host/b4_snapshot.py.note: unit 2b-4a A: K7 from the ledger alone, no engine / RunResult change — the map rebuilt under each arm's rule (O online; X relabelled through the recorded pi with a shadow on the true genome, the contract checked after every ingest against the record; F the base + 21 probes then frozen, later records held to the frozen version; given views and R not applicable, their records held to the given / absent map); O's B* prefix of exactly B + 1 records (base + B search), the four states summing to 21; the final fields held to the rebuild; the rebuilt relations for the archive.

b4/host/b4_stats.py.note: the four-corner interaction index and its four per-seed outcomes as a pure computation; tau a parameter with no default; every seed in the denominator.

b4/host/b4_thresholds.py.note: unit 2b-4a C: the machine table of docs/b4_architecture.md section 9's fixed thresholds, grid, anchor and control formulas, pinned field by field to the document's text by b4/tests/test_b4_thresholds.py; listed beside exploration values for reference; never a verdict.

b4/hypothesis/ff_behaviour_v0.2.json.note: status unverified; v0.2: machine-enum readings, clock_mode by storage context (the latch probe's finding), the domain rule, the initialisation event's allowed context, the executing-side / host-only split of the observation context; sources by kind — the vendor's UNISIM models by root + path + sha256 + the lines adopted, the certificate and docs/ff_latch_probe.md by path + sha256, the project's decode assumptions. 0.2.1: the domain_refusal and formal_input blocks. SUPERSEDED by ff_behaviour_v0.3.json on 2026-10-18 (the owner's ruling): kept byte for byte as the record of 0.2.1 — never loaded as formal (load() reads the v0.3 file only); the tests' marked v021_hole fixture is built from it after its bytes hash to this digest.
b4/hypothesis/ff_behaviour_v0.2.json.role: hypothesis (data; SUPERSEDED by v0.3, kept byte for byte)

b4/hypothesis/ff_behaviour_v0.3.json.note: THE formal hypothesis since the v0.3 unit (the owner's ruling of 2026-10-18 on the scope draft); status unverified; 0.3.0: the latch's clock-mode bit 0 reads inverted on the D1' host correspondence pair (evidence/b4/unit_d1prime_latch_ginv_attempt2_2026_10_18/probe_report.json, a repository_document source by path + sha256), through the vendor's LDCE model and the named generalisation assumptions G1-G6 (project_decode_assumption items) — the three layers in their own source entries; every assignment of the 21 bits in the domain by that added reading; the DOMAIN refusal, the unknown enum and the executing-side contract unchanged; the initialisation event's atomic, unsettled assignment named a model abstraction (A8 unresolved).

b4/probes/latch_ginv/build_ff_latch_ginv.note: the LATCH probe's build script reading the derived Verilog, passing GINV as a generic, and reading back every inversion property and every pin of every storage cell

b4/probes/latch_ginv/probe_latch_ginv.py.note: builds the pair main_latch / main_latch_ginv on the mine site with stamps, imports the analysis helpers of scripts/ read-only (named by digest in the report), buckets the full diff, verifies every cell, evaluates the expectation fixed before the build, exports the evidence; any miss archived as it came and exit 2; attempt 2: the cell rule accepts ROUTED and INTRASITE (the owner's follow-up ruling), its own raw and evidence directories, attempt 1 kept

b4/probes/latch_ginv/specimen_ff_latch_g.note: the LATCH probe's specimen family with one parameter GINV applied as IS_G_INVERTED on every LDCE (D1' latch_ginv probe); the original pinned and unchanged

b4/schemas/self_map_v3.schema.json.note: self_map 3.0.0-draft: observation relations, groups, an empty semantic_claims slot, host_verdict null; v2 untouched.

b4/tests/b4_test_fixtures.py.note: the MARKED mechanics hypothesis (the latch's clock bit 0 read as not inverted: a complete domain for exercising mechanics; says nothing about the fabric) and the injecting port. v0.3: the marked v021_hole hypothesis / fabric built from the kept v0.2 file after its bytes hash to the 0.2.1 digest.

b4/tests/test_b4_engine.py.note: complete runs under the mechanics fixture; DOMAIN injected at the base, in the probe pass and mid-generation; the two F facts — under the formal v0.3 the probe pass completes (base + 21; a complete run B + 23 observations), under the kept 0.2.1 reading (v021_hole) it terminates at the LATCH flip.

b4/tests/test_b4_ff_model.py.note: every expected trace derived by hand from the hypothesis's adopted lines, never by running the model. v0.3: the inverted-gate latch's trace derived by hand in the model's settle order (the new inputs at the old clock first; the init step atomic), the 0.2.1 refusal kept on the v021_hole fixture.

b4/tests/test_b4_probe_latch_ginv.py.note: the probe's pure parts without Vivado: per-cell verification, structure comparison, the expectation, the build cache, the recipe's fixed facts and the untouched originals

The pin table of B4 has not been generated.
